title: Log-log-depth parity hypotheses for the Juggler map: the cylinder bound H(C,A) and its weakest form, the live pressure P_theta(C)
statement: Fix N0 >= 2 with [1, N0] contained in the set R of starts that reach 1 (Lean N0 = 260; certified N0 = 3.5e8). Put L(y) = log2(log(2y)/log N0) and d(y) = ceil(C L(y)). H(C,A): for all sufficiently large y and every word w of length d(y) beginning with O, #{n odd in (y,2y] : word_{d(y)}(n) = w} <= 2^{-(d(y)-1)} y/2 + y (log y)^{-A} (odd starts have first letter O; 2^{-(d-1)} y/2 is the fair share of an O-rooted cylinder among the y/2 odd starts). Only an upper bound, only at one depth per scale, only needed for the L(y)-bad words (those whose exponent walk u_t = o_t log2 3 - t stays above -L(y) for all t <= d(y)). Theorem B of docs/theory/juggler_tao_reduction_note.md: H(C,A) with A > C + e(C) gives #{n odd in (y,2y] : n not in R} <= (y/2) (log 2y / log N0)^{-(e(C) - eps)} for every eps > 0 and y large, e(C) = C D(p_C || 1/2)/ln 2, p_C = (1 - 1/C)/log2 3. Corollary C: H(C,A) with C >= 19 (e(19) = 0.5150 > 1 - lambda*** = 0.5078; C >= 21 with the block-only exponent lambda** = 0.4050) implies that every positive integer reaches 1, via fate contagion (J-fate-log-density). Weakest form (Tao note §10, J-tao-pressure-form): with tau(n) the entrance time into [1, N0] and o_d(n) the odd count of the first d letters, P_theta(C): (1/N) sum_{n odd in (y,2y], tau(n) > d(y)} exp(theta o_d(n)) <= ((1 + e^theta)/2)^{d(y)} e^{o(d)}; at theta = log(p_C/(1 - p_C)) it gives the same Tao-type bound, and it follows from the no-momentum form M_{theta,q}: the tilted odd share s_theta(t) (share of odd next letters among live starts weighted by exp(theta o_t)) satisfies sum_{t < d(y)} (s_theta(t) - q)^+ = o(d(y)) for some q < log 2 / log 3. P_theta is one-sided and aggregated: any o(log log y) initial depths are free, towers O^t biased below (1 + e^{-theta})/2 = 0.836 are harmless, and only the tilted average split of typical odd-heavy live words at depth of order log log y matters. No bounded-depth cylinder statement can imply any of these forms (a word measure fair to depth k and all-O afterwards satisfies them all at depth <= k and violates the bound).
mathematical_domain: Juggler parity discrepancy / nested floor-power cylinders at unbounded depth
tested_range: Not testable as stated (the depth d(y) is 27 at y = 10^20, 75 at 10^100 with N0 = 3.5e8). Depth-<=4 analogue: Paper B Theorems 4.4, 4.7, 4.8, 6.1 with power savings y^{-1/96} on dyadic blocks; depth 5: Theorem 6.3 (two words). Aggregate census with the certified floor N0 = 3.5e8 as target (tao_census): for random odd starts in (y, 2y], y = 10^12 .. 10^50, the fraction of exact big-integer orbits still above N0 after d <= 40 steps matches the odd-start fair-coin probability P[u_t > -L(y) for all t <= d | u_1 = log2 3 - 1] within 3 percent for d >= 10 at every scale (ratios 0.92-1.05); the aggregate odd share along surviving prefixes is 1/2. Fair-coin bad-word probabilities by exact walk count (unconditioned first letter; odd-start conditioning roughly doubles them): 0.052 at (y, d) = (10^20, 27), 0.014 at (10^100, 75), 0.0028 at (10^1000, 145); the least depth giving rate (log y)^{-0.6} is about 17 L(y) (data/research/juggler/tao_reduction/summary.json). Pressure census (pressure_census): tilted odd share s_theta(t) in [0.44, 0.56] for t <= 40, theta in {0.396, 0.6}, y = 10^12, 10^20, 10^30, 10^50 (40000 exact orbits each); cumulative excess over 1/2 equals positive-part noise (0.14-0.26 over 40 depths); live exponential moments within 5-8 percent of the fair-coin DP.
counterexamples: none; a depth-d(y) cylinder of odd starts carrying more than (1 + (log y)^{C-A}) times its fair share at infinitely many scales would refute. Because R contains every n <= 3.5e8, a refutation below that floor is impossible; above it the statement is about parity words of length O(log log y).
lean_reference: Envelope step only: Problems/Juggler/FateContagion.lean (iterate_le_of_envelope, mem_of_envelope_floor, reachesOne_of_itinerary_envelope)
literature: Terras 1976 / Everett 1977 (Collatz parity vectors, exact equidistribution mod 2^d, density-one finite stopping time); Tao 2022, Almost all orbits of the Collatz map attain almost bounded values (growing target, renewal through Syracuse random variables); Krasikov-Lagarias 2003 (Collatz preimage trees >= x^{0.84}). Paper B (docs/theory/juggler_parity_discrepancy_note.md): depth <= 4 with power savings, Conjecture 7.3 (K_3) at depth 5, Proposition 7.1 (all-depth rate-free equidistribution implies density-one descent).
notes: One-sided form H_q(C,A) (Theorem B′, J-tao-biased-split-bound): it suffices that every cylinder of depth t < d(y) sends at most q·#[w] + y (log y)^{-A} of its members to an odd next state, for any fixed q < log 2 / log 3 = 0.6309, with C > C(q) (21 at q = 1/2, 46 at 0.55, 255 at 0.60, 1840 at 0.62; Azuma-Hoeffding on the exponent walk). The hypothesis is therefore weaker than equidistribution: no lower bound on odd shares and no vanishing error are needed. Anatomy: 99.99% of the bad fair-coin mass at (10^100, d = 75) contains an odd run >= 4 and 98.8% a run >= 5, so the content of the hypothesis is the O^t -> O^{t+1} split for t >= 4 (K_3 and its iterates), uniformly to depth O(log log y); odd runs of length 1 are transparent and runs 2-3 are Paper B. Census on (10^6, 2·10^6]: odd-share of O^t within binomial noise of 1/2 for t <= 14 (members 500000 down to 69). Relation to juggler_tower_rate_free_equidistribution: that record is fixed depth with no rate and yields density-one DESCENT; this record is depth C log2 log y with relative error o(1) and yields the CONJECTURE (through contagion). Neither implies the other formally; H(C,A) is the quantitative form in the regime where the descent reaches a fixed floor. Why log log: the Juggler descent is by powers, so the exponent walk must travel only L(y) = log2(log 2y / log N0) units to land below N0, and Chernoff at depth C L(y) leaves (log 2y / log N0)^{-e(C)} of the starts unaccounted. For Collatz the analogous depth is Theta(log y) (cylinders of one element) and even a bounded-target almost-all theorem would not imply the conjecture (thin preimage trees). Do not read this record as evidence for termination: it is the hypothesis of a conditional theorem, at the K_3 wall and beyond it. Weakest form and what it exempts: J-tao-pressure-form; intermediate almost-all-cylinder and pair-correlation forms are REPARAMETERIZATION (J-tao-cylinder-forms-reparameterization). The K_3 program (fixed depth) is neither necessary nor sufficient for the reduction; the wall is bulk depth.
